title: BANC-project: Analysis + figure-reproduction repository for the BANC connectome paper
description: R analysis pipeline that produced every figure and statistical result in Bates, Phelps, Kim, Yang et al. (2025) 'Distributed control circuits across a brain-and-cord connectome' (bioRxiv 10.1101/2025.07.31.667571). Consumes bancpipeline outputs from the Harvard Dataverse / GCS bucket and emits the per-figure illustrator-ready PDFs and tabular outputs.
